title: PhysicalLocator
description: Embeddable value object mapping content back to a coordinate in a SourceAsset: page, printed page label, bounding box, character offsets, timecodes, or a source-native fragment id. At least one locating property is required. Logical structure never depends on locators.

pageIndex.description: 0-based physical page index in the asset (PDF page index, scan index). NOT the printed number.

printedLabel.description: The page label as printed ('23', 'xiv', 'B-4'). May not be numeric or unique.

charStart.description: Start offset in the asset's extracted text stream (plaintext/HTML/XML sources).

timeStart.description: Seconds from the start of an audio/video asset.

sourceFragmentId.description: Source-native fragment id: EPUB/HTML anchor, TEI xml:id, OCR block id, subtitle cue id.
